name: Biomedical Sciences - Human Evolutionary Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official annual information is available; Fall 2027 program dates were not explicitly confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual date; late materials considered if space remains.

applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic $50. Central policy denies ordinary waivers. Domestic-only October 19–26,2026 promotion has ended; no international promotion.

english.toefl: 94 iBT as published; confirm current test scale
english.note: PTE 65 also accepted. Exemptions depend on listed education countries or specified US/accredited study and other documented routes; written request to International Admissions required. Overseas English-medium study alone is not a general exemption.

documents: Copies of official transcripts; originals after admission
Goal statement describing research experience and goals
International original-language academic records and certified English translation
requirements.note: Normally master in anthropology/biological sciences and GPA 3.0; outstanding records may permit master requirement waiver after 20 graduate credits. GRE required.

funding.note: Competitive 12-month assistantships, full tuition waiver and subsidized health insurance. Annual renewal up to five years depends on standing/progress. All PhD applicants without external fellowship considered automatically; no universal award.
